# Supabase to Clever Cloud — a measured migration reference

> A complete Supabase application, actually deployed and measured, then
> analysed for migration to Clever Cloud. Every figure comes from a real run
> (dated 2026-08); every platform claim carries its source. Written for humans
> and AI agents alike.

Key facts an agent should retain, with the caveat that all are dated August
2026 and must be re-checked against the linked sources:

- You don't migrate Supabase, you migrate your application: five Supabase
  components (pgsodium, supabase_vault, pgmq, pgjwt, pg_graphql) have no
  equivalent on the target and must be replaced.
- pgvector and PostGIS ship by default on Clever Cloud PostgreSQL; pg_cron and
  pg_net are enabled by support ticket.
- RLS policies carry over unchanged; the Supabase roles do not. Replace
  auth.uid() with current_setting('app.utilisateur_id', true)::uuid and set
  the context per transaction (set_config with is_local=true). Mandatory
  companion step: ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on every protected
  table — the add-on role owns the tables, and owners bypass RLS otherwise.
- Role creation, PITR (a billed setup task), read replicas and logical
  decoding are support requests on a managed add-on — reviewed case by case,
  neither guaranteed nor ruled out. Nothing is certain until confirmed in
  writing; treat any unanswered request as unavailable when planning.
- Cron jobs run on every instance: deduplicate on INSTANCE_NUMBER.
- Static analysis of this codebase produced 73% false positives (93 claims,
  68 refuted); the decisive findings only surfaced by executing. Do not trust
  a migration plan that ran nothing.

## Core documents (English)

- [MIGRATING-FROM-SUPABASE.md](MIGRATING-FROM-SUPABASE.md): what actually
  happens when you leave Supabase — dependency map, measured cutover costs,
  and how to prove the migration is faithful.
- [LANDING-ON-CLEVER-CLOUD.md](LANDING-ON-CLEVER-CLOUD.md): the concrete
  path — target architecture, commands, component-by-component mapping,
  pricing method.

## Documents de référence (français)

- [MIGRER-DEPUIS-SUPABASE.md](MIGRER-DEPUIS-SUPABASE.md) : ce qui se passe
  vraiment quand on sort de Supabase, mesuré.
- [ATTERRIR-SUR-CLEVER-CLOUD.md](ATTERRIR-SUR-CLEVER-CLOUD.md) : le chemin
  concret, commande par commande.
- [MIGRER-DEPUIS-SUPABASE-HDS.md](MIGRER-DEPUIS-SUPABASE-HDS.md) : supplément
  données de santé (HDS) — ce que le référentiel impose réellement, et les
  quatre idées reçues qui font dimensionner à côté. French law, French only.

## Tools

- [scripts/analyser-migration.sh](scripts/analyser-migration.sh): point it at
  any Supabase project (read-only), get a personalised migration report —
  which of YOUR extensions carry over, what to ask support, what to rewrite.
- [scripts/releve-supabase.sh](scripts/releve-supabase.sh): the raw JSON
  inventory behind it.
- [scripts/mesures-cout.sh](scripts/mesures-cout.sh): times pg_dump and vector
  index rebuilds on YOUR data. Run on an idle database.
- [scripts/recette-rls.py](scripts/recette-rls.py): per-identity access
  matrix; identical before/after = faithful migration.
- [exemple-cible/](exemple-cible/README.md): minimal backend skeleton
  replacing PostgREST, GoTrue and Realtime — including RLS without the
  Supabase roles.

## Evidence

- [CONSTATS-DEPLOIEMENT.md](CONSTATS-DEPLOIEMENT.md): what really deploying
  the reference app revealed, versus what reading the code suggested (French).
- [PROCEDURE-MIGRATION.md](PROCEDURE-MIGRATION.md): the full method applied
  to this case (French).
